evidence.note: vStream trains a lightweight linear estimator to predict counterfactual ablation effects of image regions from cached attention features, so a multimodal reasoning model's visual grounding can be displayed while it reasons rather than recomputed afterwards, at 0.024 s per 10 tokens against 1.9-2.8 s for causal baselines.
evidence.title: Real-Time Visual Attribution Streaming in Thinking Model

evidence.note: HiDrop prunes about 90% of the vision tokens in a multimodal LLM by injecting them only at the layer where visual-text fusion actually begins and then dropping them on a concave schedule with a per-layer early exit, matching baseline accuracy while training 1.72x faster.
evidence.title: HiDrop: Hierarchical Vision Token Reduction in MLLMs via Late Injection, Concave Pyramid Pruning, and Early Exit
